page.layout: One column of running text in the centre. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines they cite. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: lias mitteretur. Mox in Aegypto octogin-ta epilcopi congregati, Athanafiu injufte condemnatum efle pronunciant. Res ad Conftantinum refertur, jubet ex toto or-be apud Sardicam epilcopos congregari: atque omne judicium, quo Athanafius damnatus fuerat,retractari. Inter hæc Co-ftantinus moritur: fynodus congregata jā, Coftantino imperatore, Athanafiū ablo[?]Socrat. l.s cap. 8. uit[?]: Marcellus quoq; epilcopatui reddi-tur.Epiph. li. 3. tom. 1. contra Phot. Nam de Photino epilcopo Sirmienfi non eft refcifla fententia, quia etiam no-ftrorum judicio hæreticus probabatur. Et tamē hoc ipfum Marcellum gravabat, quia Photinus auditor ejus fuifle in ado-lescentia videbatur. Verumtamen ad Athanafii ablolutionem etiam illud accef-ferat, quod Ursatius & Valens, principes Arrianorum, cum poft fynodum Sardi-cenfem viderentur a communione fecre-ti,Trin. l. 4. c. 34. coram pofiti, a Iulio Romanæ urbis episcopo veniam popoícerunt, quod innoxium condemnaffent: meritoque cum fententia concilii Sardicenfis ablolutum profefsi funt. page.notes: Running head and page number read from a small, faint print; the "146" may be "J46". Marginal notes at the left are only partly legible, and their exact reference numbers are uncertain. "uit" is a doubtful reading of the word before "Marcellus". The word after "ablo" is cut off and uncertain. "ablo[?]" may be "ablolutus". The text ends mid-word "commu-", continued by the catchword "nione". "Ursatius" is the regularised form of "Vrfatius". The "s" in "fynodum" and similar words is a long s, written as plain s.
